title: Ending a tenancy in Western Australia
description: Notices, the final inspection and the bond when a WA tenancy ends. Summarised from Consumer Protection forms and guidance.

items.title: Use the WA notice of termination (not for unpaid rent)
items.detail: Unpaid rent uses separate termination forms after a breach notice.

items.title: Periodic tenancy without grounds: give at least 60 days' notice
Periodic tenancy after a sale needing vacant possession: give at least 30 days' notice
Fixed term ending on its expiry date: give at least 30 days' notice
Breach not fixed: give a breach notice first, then at least 7 days' notice
Do the outgoing property condition report and give the tenant a copy within 14 days of move-out
Collect all keys and security devices
Release the bond with the WA joint bond disposal form or through BondsOnline
items.detail: If you can't agree, either party can ask for a Commissioner determination.

items.title: Follow the disposal of goods notices if the tenant leaves belongings
